programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

Gail rushes to her dressing room to fetch some plants, leaving an oblivious Rapids explaining the traits of a Quizzly Bear to the real Quizzly Bear! Later, Gail decides that she needs some more camouflage and adds another plant to her very full desk.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is a big, friendly dog who runs The Squirrel Club, an after-school activity club where children can learn and take part in all kinds of activities, have fun adventures, and earn badges for their achievements.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack's stall. She chooses the fairy wand and remembers the day she got it... James asks the kids what wish they would make if they could wish for anything at all. Suki wants to be a vet, Magnus wants to build a robot and Ruby wants to feed pigs. Molly says she would like to be a fairy godmother and make all of her friends' wishes come true. She persuades Daisy to take Suki and Ruby to the farm.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Kay has invited his friends to taste his Polish dill pickle soup, which his mum has shown him how to cook all by himself. Dill pickle is a popular Polish ingredient and Kay gets his friends to taste it before they eat the soup. Not all of his friends like the taste at first, but Kay hopes they will all enjoy the finished soup. As well as dill pickle, he uses spring onions, potatoes and carrot in his soup.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how acorns play an important role in the environment. They find out how tiny acorns can grow into giant oak trees that live for hundreds of years and that acorns are a great food source for animals like squirrels who bury them to eat in winter. On the way, they spot a woodpecker's nest in an oak tree and learn that oak trees support more life than any other tree in the UK - all thanks to the tiny acorn.

programme.title: Down on the Farm
programme.desc: Storm goes to an unusual farm in London to discover how edible herbs and leaves are grown underground. Rory meets some hairy cows and finds out why they love being outside in the cold. Some children in Stevenage learn how to help birds in the winter.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: Kate helps with the keepers' plans for a lads' day out for the lions. They are putting one of the prides into another lion's territory in an attempt to analyse the current pride structure.

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Singer-songwriter and talent show judge Pixie Lott hopes to confirm a family story that she has Italian ancestry from Verona, but instead discovers ancestors battling poverty and hardship in London. On her dad's side, Pixie learns of her great-grandfather's harrowing and surprising experience in the First World War. And, wondering if she has any musical genes, Pixie is delighted to discover three generations of military musicians.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: At the Royal Navy Hospital in Gosport, finds include a satinwood secretaire, a radiograph of Edward VIII's hand, and an Edward Lear sketch.

programme.desc: Coverage from day 1 of the inaugural edition of the World Athletics Ultimate Championship.

programme.desc: The magnificent Sara Pascoe introduces comedians Amy Gledhill and Eddie Kadi to the stage.

programme.title: Newsnight

programme.title: BBC Weather
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast.

programme.title: Club Zero

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings blame Weasy for destroying their swimming pool when they wanted to cool off.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: When the Fairy Squad gets their wings gunked by Stinkweasel, the heroes must quest to end his reign of stinky nonsense over the forest.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings recover a jar of Yummy from an automatic distributor. However, before they can enjoy it, Grizzy confiscates the treat. In exchange, he leaves them the key ring that came as a gift.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is a tour guide at a stately home, but Frog decides to move in.

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series

programme.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: With Vexius' dark power growing, Alfea prepares for a looming battle, but Bloom's sudden disappearance raises alarm. Meanwhile, Bloom learns a shocking truth about her past and her family.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: The cast of the new UK tour of High School Musical perform a show-stopping song.

programme.title: Newsround

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: A young ballerina is torn between two creative but possessive men: one a struggling composer, the other an autocratic impresario. Forced to choose between her career and a happy marriage, she is persuaded to do one last performance of the role that made her famous, with tragic results.

programme.title: The Great British Sewing Bee
programme.desc: Three challenges stand between the remaining sewers and the final: leather jackets, men's shirts and a little black dress.

programme.title: Race Against the Tide
programme.desc: Five teams battle wind, waves, and time to sculpt monstrous sand creations. Six hours, one tide - who will survive this beach of horrors before they're all washed away?

programme.title: Lawrence of Arabia
programme.desc: Epic dramatisation of T E Lawrence's life and his efforts to unite the Arabs against the Turkish Empire in World War I. The film tells the story of the young desk soldier in Cairo, frustrated by lack of opportunity, who is finally given the chance to prove himself. Lawrence's complex personality is explored against a backdrop of stunning desert scenery and riveting action.
